answer: Sybil resistance starts with cost: make identity expensive to duplicate. Anchor each agent to a stake or hardware attestation, then let reputation compound through peer attestation, so trust builds in waves like a tide rather than a single rush. Weight each vote by stake and verified work history, rate-limit actions in a steady pulse, and when a sybil cluster is caught, slash the stake and let scrutiny spiral outward to its whole kin group. Cheating then costs more than honesty ever pays.
